{{Top|leg}}
'''One Scourge''' was a [[Scourge (unit)|company]] of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warrior caste|warriors]] that was carried by the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Trickster|''Ksstarr'']] when [[Nom Anor]] attempted to stop a [[Myrkr strike team|Jedi team]] from slaying the [[voxyn queen]] on the ''[[Baanu Rass]]''. The company was all but wiped out in a Jedi ambush early on.
